verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Spline shipping an MCP *server* (docs-13, docs-25, docs-36, docs-53) that external MCP clients like Claude/Cursor/Codex connect to — the reverse of this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Spline so its own AI agent can use their tools. No evidence shows Spline acting as an MCP client or consuming third-party MCP tool servers.
